base.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
base.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges.

flags.text: For lenders, operating cash flow mostly reflects loan-book growth — read with caution

guidance.statement: Management is optimistic about outpacing loan growth in the coming financial year FY27.
guidance.target: couple of percentage points above system growth (system at 12-13%)
guidance.quote: we believe and we are very optimistic about outpacing loan growth in the coming year in FY '27
guidance.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan, CEO and MD

guidance.statement: Loan-to-deposit ratio (CD ratio) is targeted to be reduced on a downward glide path towards 90% or low 90s over the next 1 to 2 years, and 85% to 90% by FY27.
guidance.quote: over the next 1 year to 2 years, we would be getting down further into the levels that we had previously been there, call it, the 90s or low 90s and so on.
guidance.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan, CFO

guidance.statement: For FY26, the CD ratio is expected to be in the range of 90% to 96%.
guidance.quote: We said we will try and be in a range of somewhere between 90% to 96% in the year FY '26, which is what we will be is what we are very confident about.
guidance.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan, CEO and MD

guidance.statement: We will continue to gain market share on deposits every year, almost around 30 to 50 basis points.
guidance.quote: We have demonstrated our ability to gain market share on deposits every year, almost around 30 to 50 basis points over the last 5 years.
guidance.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan, CEO

guidance.statement: Business banking / MSME growth is expected to continue in the 18% to 21% range.
guidance.quote: we've grown our business banking, which is mainly representative of our MSME, we've grown at about 20% year-on-year, and that will continue to also be in that range of 18% to 20%, 21%
guidance.speaker: Kaizad Bharucha, Deputy MD

segments.name: Retail and Wholesale
segments.comment: Balance sheet is about 53%, 54% in retail and the balance coming out of wholesale.

extracts.tone: Confident, as management highlighted strong deposit flows, digital/AI platform readiness, operating leverage, and stable return metrics despite a challenging operating environment.
analystConcerns: Credit growth trajectory relative to system
Deposit granularity and sustainability of high-frequency flows

guidance.statement: Management expects net interest margins to bottom in Q2 and project an upward trajectory from next quarter onwards.
guidance.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.
guidance.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

guidance.statement: The bank targets to operate its Liquidity Coverage Ratio between 110% and 120%, ideally around 115%.
guidance.quote: Yes, we would like to operate between 110 and 120, which we have told you over last few years, somewhere probably in the middle, 115.
guidance.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
